source: written by hand in the shapes of hermes_cli/stream_json.py at NousResearch/hermes-agent@2f7e62bad99052055d1db9213b81eaab26174bc4; not captured

cases.what: a completed answer in three deltas, one of them whitespace only
two parallel calls of one tool, each with its id, ending out of order; one output cut at 5000 characters

calls with no tool_call_id: one pairs by name; two open calls of one name leave a result that pairs with nothing; a call whose args are not an object has no input to digest, so its line stays raw and its result pairs with nothing
a turn that failed after some output
credentials could not be resolved: init then result, no session, every count written as 0
the client was interrupted (the work may go on at the Hermes gateway)
one-shot detached because a prompt needs a human (the turn is left parked at the gateway, not cancelled)
NOT WRITTEN BY THE PINNED stream-json PATH (it never exits 75); here to show that an exit 75 types no limit
the viewer fell behind: text stops at the gap and the result carries the whole reply
lines that are not the protocol (some the pinned emitter never writes), a second init, and lines after the result
the process was killed mid-line: no result record
call ids that are not valid call ids or use this parser's prefixes; an input with no RFC 8785 text (its line stays raw); an input too large to carry (its digest is still the input's)
text outside ASCII, for byte offsets
id-less calls of one name: a result while two are open puts the group in doubt, a call started meanwhile joins it, no result in it pairs, and once all have ended the next call pairs again
